title: Voyager Wind-Down Debtor confirms FTX settlement funded Second Distribution
notes: Official support update states that the Alameda/FTX settlement released $450 million plus interest to the Wind-Down Debtor and that those funds were distributed to Voyager creditors in the Second Distribution. It does not establish one universal recovery percentage for every creditor or a final completed estate recovery.

title: Voyager creditor portal lists February 2026 Tenth Status Report
notes: Official creditor portal lists the Plan Administrator's Tenth Status Report dated 2026-02-27. The report states that another round of creditor distributions was expected later in 2026. This supports an ongoing recovery process, not a final recovery rate or completed distribution for all claims.
